description:
These are the Top 10 Most Tragic Characters in dark anime history. From heartbreaking anime backstories to the most tragic anime characters ever created, we're counting down the children who suffered the cruelest fates in anime history. If you love sad anime, emotional anime, dark anime, anime recommendations, and Top 10 anime videos, this countdown is for you. Featuring Erased, Vinland Saga, My Hero Academia, Code Geass, Angel Beats!, Takopi's Original Sin, Future Diary, Saikano, Binchō-tan, In This Corner of the World, and more.
